Priya (CS): Heads-up — BlueLantern Labs wants a temporary APAC demo bump next Tue 08:00–20:00 UTC. They reported latency from APAC and renewal touches in ~6w. Can we grant a short QPS increase and an allowlist for their demo cluster? Details below.
Ryan (Ops): Ping @Jia — can we do a 48h burst? what's safe from infra side?
Jia (Eng): Need account id + expected peak RPS. Also any CIDR list? Could route to APAC pool, but we should avoid dedicated capacity unless committed.
Priya (CS): Account: BL-4521. Peak target: 800 QPS (current 200). CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24. Demo window 2026-06-15 08:00–20:00 UTC (48h). Renewal risk: low usage historically, churn concern — want to show latency improvement.
Sam (SE): Suggest burst policy w/ auto-revoke TTL 72h and slow start. Also enable prefix cache warmup. Example config:
```json
{
  "account": "BL-4521",
  "region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "qps": 800,
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24"],
  "auto_revoke_hrs": 72
}
```
Priya (CS): Adding request to CS ticket CS-3348 and noted renewal flag. Please attach cost estimate for billing.
Ryan (Ops): I can make the allowlist change and route to APAC pool. Jia — can you approve the temporary scale? After approval I'll run the script.
Jia (Eng): Approve for 48h with 800 QPS. I recommend observing token-level latency first hour and rollback if p95 > 1.2s. :rotating_light:
onboard-bot: change_request BL-4521 queued by Priya (CS) — workflow id wf_8821. Auto-revoke scheduled in 72h unless extended.
Sam (SE): Also capture customer feedback prompt in demo: ask them to run our latency trace script and send trace id.
Priya (CS): Will send trace link and schedule enablement call Mon 17:00 UTC. Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update CRM with renewal note and next steps.
Ryan (Ops): Done. Allowlist added, routing rule in place. Script: `./apply-temp-burst --acct BL-4521 --region ap-northeast-1 --qps 800 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24` — started 4133779400.
Priya (CS): Closing notes: ticket CS-3348 updated with notes + cost est. Follow-up plan: 1) Observe metrics 2) Collect feedback 3) Schedule renewal outreach in 4w. :spiral_calendar:
